verdict.rationale: Wise offers building blocks a user could wire into their own month-end close automation: balance statements via API in accounting-friendly formats (CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), webhooks for transaction events, and an llms.txt file that helps AI tooling work with the API. There is no evidence of any first-party AI automation or accounting-software integration, so the user would need to build and connect everything themselves. Missing for 10: native AI-driven reconciliation or categorization, direct accounting-platform sync (e.g., Xero/QuickBooks), documented month-end close workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
